notes: Scan035 carries dark authorial5 at the top centre and pale secondary34 at the bottom left. The opening allusion sentence is a continuation. The page ends in a crowded neighbourhood formula at the right paper edge without terminal punctuation; no continuation is invented.

In the upper third, alors and de groupoïdes are separate above-line additions with distinct leaders. The underline begins under type rather than le and separately underlines de. The cancelled Z-like symbol before live X remains unresolved.

The opening parenthesis reads son capital Pi1, not les Pii. The later certains Pi_i also uses a capital Pi. Both symbols have the same broad upper bar and tall legs; no mathematical argument was used to replace an index.

The reference to diagramme (8) has both parentheses and its following comma. There is no H dash before ou or comma after ou. The next line writes a literal equals sign before du diagramme de groupes (10); that abbreviation is retained rather than expanded.
En tous cas retains the written final s-like return. The indépendam-/ment division is physical line wrapping and is not counted as a lexical difference.

The first catégorie has a doubtful ss addition before it and a doubtful ornate F after it, each with a separate leader. The same ornate F family recurs above Cette catégorie. Both calligraphic/Fraktur alternatives remain open. The barred and looped sign courses are not declared cancelled merely because they cross; the independent insertion leaders remain distinct.

Dont is visibly cancelled in the faisceaux sentence. The retained formée des F clause is live. Formula16 has ordinary restriction bars and a clear handwritten16; its heavily retraced terminal stays comma/semicolon doubtful.

Formula17 has a clear handwritten17, the full E-index tuple and varphi. Two small dark points appear above and slightly left of its large comma separator. They are represented by two dot glyph nodes and one comma glyph node; the punctuation is not regularised to a one-dot semicolon or drawn as strokes.

The lower left has two cancelled fragments, formés and d’un, on different local baselines. Formés remains an existing C doubt; d’un receives new uncertainty in its heavily covered ending. The complete où E_Xstar est un phrase is added above, with a leader into the retained système construction.

The first covering parenthesis above/right is live. The long line below it attaches it after Pi1Xstar and is not a strike. Its visible middle pen gap and curled right tip are retained. A separate short leader attaches the small adjective before de X-star/plus inside that parenthesis.

The first arrow has opposed tips but a heavily retraced body. Leftrightarrow versus Leftrightarrow-with-double-shaft remains unresolved. The first adjective is written as the short form étle or ét.le, without an independently visible a; its internal point remains doubtful. The superscript on this parenthetical X remains asterisk/plus doubtful.

The second local-system formula has a calligraphic V. Above it, two waves sit over a separate left arrow before Pi1Y; a different curved line is the insertion leader. No parentheses are supplied around that addition. The following smaller opening parenthesis belongs to the covering explanation.

The second parenthetical mark resolves to leftrightarrow on one shaft. The following adjective is literally ét.le, with a point between t and l and no terminal point after e. The closing de Y parenthesis is followed by a clear varphi, not the word enfin.

The final neighbourhood sign is calligraphic. Its star is recognisable at the edge, but its cramped last index remains lambda/X doubtful. The uncertainty is retained locally without using expected notation to complete its crossing.
